scripts.docker:prune: docker compose down -v --rmi all --remove-orphans && docker volume prune -f
scripts.setup: cp -n services/games/.env.example services/games/.env && cp -n services/wallets/.env.example services/wallets/.env
scripts.test: cd services/games && bunx prisma generate && bun test tests/unit && cd ../wallets && bunx prisma generate && bun test tests/unit
scripts.test:e2e: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.test.yml up -d && cd services/games && bun test tests/e2e
scripts.test:coverage: cd services/games && bunx prisma generate && bun test tests/unit --coverage && cd ../wallets && bunx prisma generate && bun test tests/unit --coverage
